_comment: Gate 3 (standard-cell technology mapping) evidence. Committed on purpose: hardware/asic/build/ and results/ are both gitignored, so numbers kept only there cannot be audited later. Bulky logs stay ignored; this file is the authoritative record.

scope_and_limits.memories: kept as $mem_v2 via `memory -nomap`; mapping them to flip-flops would report an area no real chip would have. Real SRAM macros are Gate 4.

reproduction.note_on_tooling: yowasp-yosys (WebAssembly) could not finish this: without flatten it re-parses the 12.8 MB Liberty per module (20+ times observed) and with flatten one ABC call ran over 40 minutes without completing. Native Yosys in the container does the same work in seconds.

supersedes.claim: SkyWater 130nm ASIC synthesis PASSED with 1,383 standard cells / 327,884 logic cells
supersedes.why_wrong: Those counts were generic Yosys RTLIL primitives ($add, $mux, $sdff, $mem_v2) from an elaboration-only script that never ran `abc -liberty`. No standard cell was instantiated and no um2 area existed.
